name: Maggie Veggie Masala
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Refined wheat flour (Maida), Palm oil, Iodized salt, Wheat gluten, Thickeners (508 & 412), Acidity regulators (501(i) & 500 (i)) and Humectant (451(i)). Masala *TASTEMAKER*: Mixed spices (24.4%) (Red chilli powder, Dehydrated onion (4%), Coriander powder, Turmeric powder, Dehydrated garlic, Cumin powder, Aniseed powder, Black pepper powder, Fenugreek powder, Ginger powder, Clove powder, Green cardamom powder & Nutmeg powder), Dehydrated vegetables (18.6%) (Carrot bits (9.3%) & Green french beans (9.3%)), Refined wheat flour (Maida), Iodized salt, Sugar, Starch, Palm oil, Toasted onion flakes (3.7%), Flavour enhancer (635), Acidity regulator (330), Colour (150d), Yeast extract powder, Mineral and Wheat gluten. Allergen Note: Contains Wheat. May contain Oats, Milk & Soy.
